scenario.goal_zh: 讨论角色形象及设计修改并确认下一版草图。

context_zh: 插画师安吉向客户托马斯展示儿童活动用的卡通角色草图。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Thomas
sentences.text: I like the giant, but his expression looks rather angry.

sentences.speaker: Angie
sentences.text: He is meant to protect an imaginary village. Should I make him look less threatening?

sentences.speaker: Thomas
sentences.text: Yes. The children should want to ask him for help.

sentences.speaker: Angie
sentences.text: What if he uses magic to grow flowers instead of carrying that enormous hammer?

sentences.speaker: Thomas
sentences.text: That suits the gardening activity much better. Could the flowers be yellow and blue?

sentences.speaker: Angie
sentences.text: Certainly. I will soften his eyebrows, remove the hammer, and add flowers around his hands.

sentences.speaker: Thomas
sentences.text: Great. Please send that version before we choose the poster background.
